notes.title: 🩸 New System: Dynamic Cloth Tearing 🩸
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/cf7c0b781670ded1458f77bf12afb98360726293.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/83e433bd45033ea4e12b2035b38dfad78f052a82.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With the new [b]Dynamic Cloth Tearing[/b] system, the protagonist’s outfit reacts in real time to the damage she takes: seams strain, fabric tears, and cuts accumulate with every encounter.[/p][p]In upcoming updates, Cira's clothing status will impact gameplay.[/p][p]For now, you can enjoy the views.[/p][p]Get ready to feel the fight in a whole new way.[/p][p][/p][p]Play the game on [url="https://www.patreon.com/TheAesthetik" style="button" buttoncolor="#000000"]Patreon [/url]or [url="https://subscribestar.adult/theaesthetik" style="button" buttoncolor="#37fb78"]Subscribestar[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🩸 Sera Lindvale – The Most Fragile Flower of CANOPY-6 🩸
notes.notes: [h3]🩸 Sera Lindvale – The Most Fragile Flower of CANOPY-6 🩸[/h3][p][/p][p]Sera wasn’t meant to be here. She was just a lab assistant — a sweet, quiet girl who dreamed of studying botany, not surviving a bio-nightmare. When Cira finds her, Sera is alone, disoriented… and visibly affected.[/p][p][/p][p]🌫️ How will Cira’s first encounter with a survivor unfold? 🌫️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/334b79f8a3032b3ed341ddd6f003b0ae519b06d0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/5db84188f146920662bb7a43b48c12f7a1402e28.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/9a412572a0d8b9a787dd54ab78c94eb16e79f2e1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Item Combinations
notes.notes: [p]Here's a very important new feature: the ability to combine items.[/p][p]Following in the footsteps of the genre's greats, inventory management is an essential feature in any classic survival horror.[/p][p]Need to free up space in your inventory? No problem, combine items to compress the contents.[/p][p]Stuck on a puzzle? Try combining key objects; you might be in for a surprise.[/p][p]Don't find your consumables useful enough? Combine them for a much more powerful version.[/p][p]With this new mechanic I can add much more interesting and satisfying puzzles for players without them being overly complex.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="cGC82ovdjYg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dynamic map!
notes.notes:
[p]Dynamic map!

This is essential for navigating Canopy-6. You'll be able to see if the doors are unlocked, points of interest, save points, etc.

This way, you'll find your way around much more easily.
[/p][list][*][p]Cira's current position and rotation to help you find your way around[/p][/*][*][p]Icons for points of interest (save station, changing room, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Names of important rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Floor change icons[/p][/*][*][p]Doors with their current locked/unlocked/infected status[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to navigate between different floors[/p][/*][/list][p]The map will be updated as new features and functionality are added to the gameplay.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/a890c7f912d52ed836a2b83026d1c345aab882f1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Cira face change
notes.notes: [h1]Cira face change[/h1][p][/p][p]Cira's face initially had a stylized style, as I was originally testing a cel-shading/toon style for the project (this was partly for better optimization, as rendering this way would allow me to use lower-resolution textures).[/p][p]In the end, I achieved very good performance in the game, so I decided to give it a realistic style.[/p][p]Consequently, Cira's face needs to be modified to fit the game's visual style.[/p][p]Here are some renders of the change for comparison.[/p][p]The change is now integrated into the game.[/p][p]Hope you like it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/e7610287e3a811061a9ffe4dedb71f4b635ead2d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/4e9f8a6418d3bd5aa1571acd7c65ae2a0a0ef4e9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/ba3d8a89e19c64bb48b479ee848567ebd4dd24c9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/b9c15e1907587bcdaef0a5ed88b0d11a399e41a9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/b1d6f56b7732d41e044e70e371a501932b1f4d12.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/9afad9fc53d782322b31c9e25eb64594c17a4bcd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Follow the development on [url="https://patreon.com/TheAesthetik?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=copyLink"]Patreon[/url] or [url="https://subscribestar.adult/theaesthetik"]Suscribestar[/url][/p]
